note: Read by 3ds/tools/azt.ps1. debug = the -Debug switch string of run_azahar.ps1, until = its -Until regex, cap = -Timeout in s, extra = more run_azahar.ps1 switches. first_marker is a log regex that must appear within deadline s after the Azahar start. expects = warp | tour | none (warp and tour turn on the attract-loop check). expected_events are log regexes that must all appear. status = verified | unverified | completion_only | fail_demo | pending.

scenarios.name: yard
scenarios.subject: Mario in his yard (kmr_20, entry 4), in control, at scene frames 200 and 204 (the shot writer takes one shot every 4 frames).
scenarios.proves: A preset start loads the yard map and runs steady frames with shots.

scenarios.name: tour_k30
scenarios.subject: Mario in each map of tour_k30.txt (file has 6 maps: kmr_20, kmr_21, kmr_22, kmr_23, kmr_24, kmr_30) after a warp to arn_02.
scenarios.proves: warp= plus a story and a tour file from the SD folder runs to the end of the file.
scenarios.debug: warp=arn_02:0 story=ch0_toad_town tour=@tour_k30.txt texmax shots shotwin=999999:1 shotmode=4:21
scenarios.reason: Log checks pass (run 3: tour: done, 6 maps, 17 s). Picture check fails: the file holds 6 maps, not 30, and 4 of 7 shots show no map view (a grey page, the Prologue title card and a text box), so Mario is not in view there. Needs a picture check or a shot window that avoids the cards.

scenarios.name: tour_no_warp
scenarios.subject: Deliberately wrong: a tour without warp=, preset= or story=. The game starts at the title and attract screen, and no map is loaded.
scenarios.proves: Fail-fast: the first marker is missing, azt.ps1 stops the run at the deadline and exits 2.
scenarios.reason: Demo of the fail-fast path. Not a test of the map tour.
